content: Taylor Swift is one of the biggest music artists in modern times. From 2023 to late 2024, the Eras Tour took her all over the world to play nearly 150 shows for millions of fans. It was a monumental moment in her career, and it earned $2 billion in ticket sales, becoming the highest-grossing tour of all time. Grand Theft Auto 6 grossed double that amount, in just four days.
